newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish bank BOS says its IPO oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Polish bank BOS says its IPO oversubscribed.

text.p: Investors subscribed for 13,071,226 shares of the Polish bank Bank Ochrony Srodowiska SA 's (BOS) 1.2-million-share initial public offering, the bank said in a statement on Thursday.
It said that in the 800,000-share large investor tranche buyers subscribed for 9,343,062 shares and in the 400,000-share small investor tranche 3,728,164 shares were subscribed.
It said in the large investor tranche orders would be reduced by 90.4 percent for those who signalled their orders in the book-building process and 93.4 percent for others. @
In the small investor tranche the orders would be reduced by 89.2 percent.
The shares were priced at 29 zlotys.

BOS, which seeks Warsaw bourse main market listing in January, specialises in funding environmental protection projects. It had a net profit of 31.8 million zlotys in 1995 on 210.6 million zlotys in interest and other related revenues.
